parameters.command:
set +e
TEST_DIR="/tmp/nbj-media-preflight-v03"
M4B_FILE="$TEST_DIR/NBJ_HETZNER_MEDIA_PREFLIGHT_v03.m4b"
mkdir -p "$TEST_DIR"
rm -f "$M4B_FILE"
YT_DLP_PATH="$(command -v yt-dlp 2>/dev/null)"
FFMPEG_PATH="$(command -v ffmpeg 2>/dev/null)"
FFPROBE_PATH="$(command -v ffprobe 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -n "$YT_DLP_PATH" ]; then YT_DLP_FOUND=true; YT_DLP_VERSION="$(yt-dlp --version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"; else YT_DLP_FOUND=false; YT_DLP_VERSION=""; fi
if [ -n "$FFMPEG_PATH" ]; then FFMPEG_FOUND=true; FFMPEG_VERSION="$(ffmpeg -version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"; else FFMPEG_FOUND=false; FFMPEG_VERSION=""; fi
if [ -n "$FFPROBE_PATH" ]; then FFPROBE_FOUND=true; FFPROBE_VERSION="$(ffprobe -version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"; else FFPROBE_FOUND=false; FFPROBE_VERSION=""; fi
M4B_CREATED=false
M4B_SIZE_BYTES=0
M4B_DURATION_SECONDS=""
if [ "$FFMPEG_FOUND" = true ] && [ "$FFPROBE_FOUND" = true ]; then
  ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo" -t 2 -c:a aac -b:a 64k -movflags +faststart -f mp4 "$M4B_FILE"
  if [ -s "$M4B_FILE" ]; then
    M4B_CREATED=true
    M4B_SIZE_BYTES="$(wc -c < "$M4B_FILE" | tr -d ' ')"
    M4B_DURATION_SECONDS="$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$M4B_FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
  fi
fi
echo "WORKFLOW_VERSION=v.03"
echo "TEST_DIR=$TEST_DIR"
echo "M4B_FILE=$M4B_FILE"
echo "YT_DLP_FOUND=$YT_DLP_FOUND"
echo "YT_DLP_PATH=$YT_DLP_PATH"
echo "YT_DLP_VERSION=$YT_DLP_VERSION"
echo "FFMPEG_FOUND=$FFMPEG_FOUND"
echo "FFMPEG_PATH=$FFMPEG_PATH"
echo "FFMPEG_VERSION=$FFMPEG_VERSION"
echo "FFPROBE_FOUND=$FFPROBE_FOUND"
echo "FFPROBE_PATH=$FFPROBE_PATH"
echo "FFPROBE_VERSION=$FFPROBE_VERSION"
echo "M4B_CREATED=$M4B_CREATED"
echo "M4B_SIZE_BYTES=$M4B_SIZE_BYTES"
echo "M4B_DURATION_SECONDS=$M4B_DURATION_SECONDS"
echo "MAC_REQUIRED=false"

1. Open **Test AirNow API**.

3. Run the workflow manually.
4. A successful run ends with `status: PASS`.

The test requests current observations near Seattle without storing the key in the workflow.

parameters.command:
set -eu

HOST_NAME="$(hostname)"
REMOTE_USER="$(whoami)"
RUN_UTC="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"

printf 'WORKFLOW_VERSION=v.04\n'
printf 'HOST=%s\n' "$HOST_NAME"
printf 'USER=%s\n' "$REMOTE_USER"
printf 'DATE_UTC=%s\n' "$RUN_UTC"

for TOOL in yt-dlp ffmpeg ffprobe python3; do
  KEY="$(printf '%s' "$TOOL" | tr '[:lower:]-' '[:upper:]_')"

  if command -v "$TOOL" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf '%s_FOUND=true\n' "$KEY"
    printf '%s_PATH=%s\n' "$KEY" "$(command -v "$TOOL")"
  else
    printf '%s_FOUND=false\n' "$KEY"
    printf '%s_PATH=\n' "$KEY"
  fi
done

printf 'YT_DLP_VERSION=%s\n' "$(yt-dlp --version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)"
printf 'FFMPEG_VERSION=%s\n' "$(ffmpeg -version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)"
printf 'FFPROBE_VERSION=%s\n' "$(ffprobe -version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)"
printf 'PYTHON3_VERSION=%s\n' "$(python3 --version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)"
printf 'MAC_REQUIRED=false\n'

BUILD_LOG="/srv/biketour-amrita-infra/00_GENERAL_BUILDLOG.md"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$BUILD_LOG")"

{
  printf '\n## %s - NBJ Hetzner SSH media preflight\n' "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')"
  printf '%s\n' '- Workflow: v.04.nbj_hetzner_ssh_preflight'
  printf '%s\n' '- Action: Tested n8n SSH connectivity and server-side media-tool availability.'
  printf '%s\n' '- Tools checked: yt-dlp, ffmpeg, ffprobe, python3.'
  printf '%s\n' "- Remote host: $HOST_NAME"
  printf '%s\n' "- Remote user: $REMOTE_USER"
  printf '%s\n' '- Mac required: false'
} >> "$BUILD_LOG"

printf 'BUILD_LOG_UPDATED=%s\n' "$BUILD_LOG"

parameters.jsCode: const run = $('Initialize Run Metadata').first().json; const items=$input.all(); const branches=items.map(i => i.json || {}); const source_health=[], events=[], advisories=[], observations=[], source_warnings=[], source_errors=[]; for (const b of branches) { if (b.source_health) source_health.push(b.source_health); for (const e of b.events || []) events.push(e); for (const a of b.advisories || []) advisories.push(a); for (const o of b.observations || []) observations.push(o); for (const w of b.warnings || []) source_warnings.push(b.source_id + ': ' + w); for (const e of b.errors || []) source_errors.push(b.source_id + ': ' + e); } return [{ json:{ ...run, source_health, normalized_events:events, normalized_advisories:advisories, normalized_observations:observations, source_warnings, source_errors, branch_count:branches.length } }];

const input=$input.first().json; const eventMap=new Map(); for (const e of input.normalized_events || []) { const k=e.ownership_dedupe_key || e.source_event_id || e.event_id; if (!eventMap.has(k)) eventMap.set(k,e); else { const old=eventMap.get(k); eventMap.set(k, (e.route_distance_miles ?? Infinity) < (old.route_distance_miles ?? Infinity) ? {...e, related_source_ids:Array.from(new Set([old.source_id,e.source_id]))} : {...old, related_source_ids:Array.from(new Set([old.source_id,e.source_id]))}); } } const advisoryMap=new Map(); for (const a of input.normalized_advisories || []) { const k=a.ownership_dedupe_key || a.advisory_id; if (!advisoryMap.has(k)) advisoryMap.set(k,a); } const observationMap=new Map(); for (const o of input.normalized_observations || []) if (!observationMap.has(o.observation_id)) observationMap.set(o.observation_id,o); return [{ json:{ ...input, deduplicated_events:Array.from(eventMap.values()), deduplicated_advisories:Array.from(advisoryMap.values()), deduplicated_observations:Array.from(observationMap.values()) } }];

const input=$input.first().json; const sectionMap=Object.fromEntries([["01_uw_u_district","UW / U-District"],["02_burke_gilman_seattle","Burke-Gilman - Seattle"],["03_burke_gilman_north_lake_wa_kenmore","Burke-Gilman - north Lake WA/Kenmore"],["04_burke_gilman_connector_bothell","Burke-Gilman/connector - Bothell"],["05_sammamish_river_trail_bothell_woodinville","Sammamish River Trail - Bothell/Woodinville"],["06_sammamish_river_trail_redmond","Sammamish River Trail - Redmond"],["07_marymoor_park","Marymoor Park"],["08_east_lake_sammamish_trail_redmond","East Lake Sammamish Trail - Redmond"],["09_east_lake_sammamish_trail_sammamish","East Lake Sammamish Trail - Sammamish"],["10_issaquah_approach_terminus","Issaquah approach / terminus"]].map(([segment_id,segment_name]) => [segment_id,{segment_id,segment_name,status:'clear',severity:'none',reason_codes:[],event_ids:[],advisory_ids:[]}])); const rank={none:0,low:1,moderate:2,high:3,extreme:4}; const mark=(id,p) => { const s=sectionMap[id]; if (!s) return; if ((rank[p.severity] || 0) >= (rank[s.severity] || 0)) { if (p.status) s.status=p.status; if (p.severity) s.severity=p.severity; } if (p.reason_code && !s.reason_codes.includes(p.reason_code)) s.reason_codes.push(p.reason_code); if (p.event_id && !s.event_ids.includes(p.event_id)) s.event_ids.push(p.event_id); if (p.advisory_id && !s.advisory_ids.includes(p.advisory_id)) s.advisory_ids.push(p.advisory_id); }; for (const e of input.deduplicated_events || []) { const ids=Array.isArray(e.segment_ids) && e.segment_ids.length ? e.segment_ids : Object.keys(sectionMap); for (const id of ids) mark(id,{status:e.event_type === 'fire_related_closure' ? 'closed' : 'nearby_fire', severity:e.severity || 'moderate', reason_code:e.event_type === 'evacuation' ? 'WILDFIRE_EVACUATION' : 'WILDFIRE_NEAR_ROUTE', event_id:e.event_id}); } for (const a of input.deduplicated_advisories || []) { const ids=a.route_relevance === 'route_wide' || !Array.isArray(a.segment_ids) ? Object.keys(sectionMap) : a.segment_ids; const status=a.advisory_type === 'smoke_plume' ? 'smoke_affected' : (a.advisory_type === 'burn_restriction' ? 'burn_restriction_context' : 'warning_area'); const reason=a.advisory_type === 'smoke_plume' ? 'NOAA_HMS_SMOKE' : (a.advisory_type === 'burn_restriction' ? 'KING_COUNTY_BURN_RESTRICTION' : 'NWS_FIRE_WEATHER_ALERT'); for (const id of ids) mark(id,{status,severity:a.severity || 'low',reason_code:reason,advisory_id:a.advisory_id}); } return [{ json:{ ...input, route_sections:Object.values(sectionMap) } }];

const input=$input.first().json; const errors=[], warnings=[]; for (const f of ['schema_version','connector_id','connector_name','connector_version','lane','run_id','generated_at','output_root','canonical_gpx']) if (!(f in input) || input[f] === null || input[f] === undefined || input[f] === '') errors.push('Missing required root field: '+f); for (const [field,label] of [['source_health','source_health'],['deduplicated_events','deduplicated_events'],['deduplicated_advisories','deduplicated_advisories'],['deduplicated_observations','deduplicated_observations'],['route_sections','route_sections']]) if (!Array.isArray(input[field])) errors.push(label+' must be an array'); const sev=['none','low','moderate','high','extreme'], rel=['confirmed_route_impact','near_route','route_wide','segment_specific','contextual_only','not_route_relevant'], meth=['point_distance','polygon_intersection','fire_zone_match','county_match','service_area_match','named_trail_match','point_in_polygon','manual_review']; for (const e of input.deduplicated_events || []) { for (const f of ['event_id','source_id','event_type','title','severity','route_relevance','route_match_method']) if (!(f in e) || e[f] === null || e[f] === undefined || e[f] === '') errors.push('Event missing required field: '+f+' ('+(e.event_id || 'unknown')+')'); if (!['wildfire','prescribed_burn','fire_related_closure','evacuation'].includes(e.event_type)) errors.push('Invalid event_type: '+e.event_type); if (!sev.includes(e.severity)) errors.push('Invalid severity: '+e.severity); if (!rel.includes(e.route_relevance)) errors.push('Invalid route_relevance: '+e.route_relevance); if (!meth.includes(e.route_match_method)) errors.push('Invalid route_match_method: '+e.route_match_method);
